title: Norway · live situation
description: Explore Norway's live road cameras, measured road weather, traffic and roadworks, and MET warning areas. Cameras and stations are discovered from current provider catalogues, not a fixed list. Click map symbols and warning polygons to inspect evidence, advice and on-demand images or video.
objectives: Build a sourced picture across Norway; distinguish observations, scheduled roadworks, warnings and camera availability.
Inspect original evidence, measurement times, warning validity and provider advice. Missing coverage is not proof that nothing happened.
Open the Run Assistant to discover sources and summarize retained evidence. Media references do not give the assistant video understanding.

guide.title: Read live evidence responsibly
guide.description: Live-time observation, not a fast-forward scenario. Source availability and validity are part of every conclusion.

steps.title: Discover active sources
steps.instruction: Open Situation Monitor. Inspect active sources and current coverage; an empty or failed source is explicit missing evidence.

steps.title: Read observation and validity times
steps.instruction: Select a current record and compare observation time, fetched time and validity. A scheduled roadwork notice or warning is not necessarily an observed current incident.

steps.title: Ask the Assistant
steps.instruction: Edit and send the suggestion. Inspect the actual response and its cited reads. If no provider is available, Skip and inspect source records manually. A camera listing does not prove image understanding.

action.text: Summarise the currently available Norway situation observations. Cite original evidence and distinguish expired, scheduled, missing and current coverage.

steps.title: Inspect a coverage gap
steps.instruction: Find a missing, unavailable or expired source, or explicitly record that none is currently shown. Explain what cannot be concluded. Do not fabricate a deterministic fault or media interpretation to complete the tour.

steps.title: Continue in live time
steps.instruction: Follow source refreshes in wall time and keep original evidence links with your conclusions. This scenario does not support fast-forwarding external events.

steps.title: Continue exploring
steps.instruction: This guide is finished. The same Run remains available. Pause or stop guidance whenever you wish; those controls do not pause the shared simulation. Copy the Run before trying a different intervention. Acknowledgements record your choice to continue, not a qualification.
